claim_boundary: predictive-information benchmark only; NOT an executable betting backtest; NOT a profitability/ROI/CLV claim; NOT a decision-time execution claim

population_policy.description: Matches derived from the M3-R2 canonical accepted observations (38,616) with: valid FTR label from the same pinned source rows, and at least minimum_bookmaker_count valid closing bookmaker triples. Observed population: 888 unique canonical matches (377 x 2022/23, 379 x 2023/24, 132 x 2024/25). The 4 kickoff-conflict candidates of the 892 source population have no observation rows by M3 design and are therefore absent from the evaluation population.
population_policy.exact_link_sensitivity: population is identical to the exact-link subset (all 888 matches carry match_link.matched_id); sensitivity recomputed explicitly
population_policy.bookmaker_exclusion_reason: synthetic derived columns (max across bookmakers / average across bookmakers), not independent market quotes; excluding avoids double-counting; frozen pre-OOS. (No Max/Avg observations exist in the M3 canonical dataset; rule is a guard.)

season_assignment_rule: kickoff_at month >= 8 -> YYYY/YYYY+1 else (YYYY-1)/YYYY (Europe/London kickoff, as emitted by M3)

season_split_policy.split_invariant: max(train kickoff) < min(test kickoff) per fold

feature_contract.generation: sequential chronological: for each match, features computed from team state BEFORE kickoff (state updated only AFTER the feature row is frozen); matches sharing the same kickoff_at are processed as a batch (features for all from pre-batch state, then all results applied)
feature_contract.missing_policy: missing stays missing; SimpleImputer(median) fitted on training fold rows only

model_family_note: multinomial is the only LogisticRegression behavior in sklearn >= 1.5 (the old multi_class parameter was removed in 1.8); the family is therefore exactly multinomial logistic regression with these hyperparameters.
market_no_vig_method: proportional: q_k = 1/odds_k; overround = q_H+q_D+q_A; p_k = q_k/overround; triple valid iff all three selections present, odds finite and > 1; invalid bookmaker triples excluded, never guessed
market_consensus_method: for every eligible match: (1) no-vig probabilities independently per valid bookmaker; (2) arithmetic mean across bookmakers; (3) renormalize final H/D/A vector to sum exactly 1
eligibility_fail: MARKET_BENCHMARK_INELIGIBLE (match excluded from primary comparison, not imputed)
log_loss_formula: mean over matches of -log(p_actual) with p clipped to [eps, 1]
brier_formula: mean over matches of sum_k (p_k - y_k)^2
statistical_inference_method: deterministic season-stratified paired bootstrap on per-match delta_log_loss (model - market)
primary_claim_basis: pooled OOS; fold-specific results always reported separately

determinism.runs: RUN_A and RUN_B from identical code/inputs/protocol
determinism.requirement: byte-stable JSON/CSV outputs (no wall-clock in any business hash)
